rows.ambiguity: Neither the SEC exhibit text nor the BioSpace mirror displays an explicit clock time in the dateline (both show only the date). The SEC 8-K acceptance timestamp (06:40:29 ET) is used as the best available primary-source proxy for the publication time; it is pre-market regardless of the exact minute, so the PRE_MARKET session classification and T0 cutoff are not sensitive to this imprecision.

The FDA itself typically also publishes approval actions the same day (often mid-day, well before SAGE's 21:08 ET 8-K); no primary source giving the FDA's own exact announcement time was found, so it is possible the true first-public timestamp was earlier in the day during market hours rather than after close. This is recorded using only the issuer's own disclosure as a conservative, directly-evidenced anchor rather than guessing an earlier FDA time. If an earlier FDA-side primary source is later found, this row should be revised - the cutoff session could move from 2019-03-19 to 2019-03-18.

rows.evidence_note: Released during the ASH Annual Meeting, mid-day ET while the market was open; since the 2023-12-09 session was not yet complete at release time, the last complete prior session (2023-12-08) is used as the cutoff.
